justifications.r1: Standard on-curve ramp and land base; plays at regular tempo.
justifications.r2: Reliable draw package keeping hands stocked without explosive burst.
justifications.a1: Functional redundancy and moderate selection to assemble synergy pieces.
justifications.a2: Assembles primary synergy engine on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p1: Presents must-answer board state on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps to convert a lethal board state into a win.
justifications.p3: Board-based game plan with standard interaction windows.
justifications.i1: Fair instant-speed spot removal suite with 2–3 board wipes.
justifications.i2: Light incidental taxation or soft denial; no asymmetric locks.
justifications.s1: Moderate protection suite for commander and key permanents.
justifications.s2: Can rebuild board presence over 2 turn cycles following a wipe.
justifications.s3: Commander is primary engine centerpiece; functions at reduced efficiency without it.
